    extension past the end points). -> (r0, c0, alpha) or None."""

        return None
    ex, ey = ((x1 - x0) / L, (y1 - y0) / L) if L >= 1e-7 else (1.0, 0.0)
    nx, ny = -ey, ex

+    rr = np.clip(np.rint(out[:, 0]).astype(int), 0, dist.shape[0] - 1)

+    for i in range(1, n):
+        area = int(stats[i, cv2.CC_STAT_AREA])
